Name: Motorcycles (Content Patcher)
Author: ElectroCrumpet
Description:
This mod uses modified assets from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/413]Durarara Motorcycle[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2754]Dirt Bike[/url]﻿ by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/15040154]Drex[/url]﻿ with permission.


[size=4]Installation[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher.[/url]﻿
[*]﻿Unzip this mod into Stardew Valley/Mods﻿.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=4]Color options[/size]
There are 13 predefined colors to choose from. You can change the loadout by setting [code]config.json[/code] to one of the following:

[font=Monospace]    ﻿Key         Color
    ---         -----
    ﻿aeon        silver
    aurora      light blue
    basilisk    green
    blondie     yellow
    emperor     purple
    hatsune     teal
    jackal      black
    mako        blue
    neon        pink
    patriot     red (default)
    scarab      light green
    tempest     brown
    whiplash    orange
[/font]       

You can also make a custom bike as follows:
[list=1]
[*]Create your image using any photo editing software
[*]Save as .png to [code]assets[/code]
[*]Add the new filename to the list of bikes in [code]content.json[/code]
[*]Edit [code]config.json[/code] to grab your changes
[/list]
